verdicts.reason: A: the two-line headline is so large it crowds the top edge and outweighs everything else. The CTA button is oversized, the legal text is squeezed into an unreadably tiny two-line block beside the button, and the logo and can are jammed onto the decorative circle at the left edge. B: it is a clean banner layout with the can on the left and a centred column on the right (logo, headline, CTA, readable legal text), but the decorative circles are squashed into ellipses and pushed against the right edge, and the can floats a bit small in a large empty left area.
